title: VIX futures and options December 2027 expiration (SOQ settlement) — the one row where this calendar and the OCC's published calendar disagree, resolved on the venue's own contract files
source: EST: CBOE'S RULE READ DIRECT THIS SESSION AND ADJUDICATED AGAINST CBOE'S OWN PER-CONTRACT DATA, 2026-09-09. THE RULE, READ NOT CITED: cboe.com/tradable_products/vix/vix_futures/specifications/ (HTTP 200, 461,361 bytes) -- the proposer could not extract the specification body and cited it from a sibling ledger; this session pulled it out of the page's embedded payload verbatim: "The final settlement date for a contract with the \"VX\" ticker symbol is on the Wednesday that is 30 days prior to the third Friday of the calendar month immediately following the month in which the contract expires", with the clause "If that Wednesday or the Friday that is 30 days following that Wednesday is a Cboe Options holiday, the final settlement date for the contract shall be on the business day immediately preceding that Wednesday." APPLIED TO VX/Z7: January 2028's third Friday is 2028-01-21, the Wednesday 30 days prior is 2027-12-22, and neither leg is a Cboe Options holiday (MLK 2028 is Monday 2028-01-17; the 2027-12-24 Christmas-observed closure is neither leg). The clause does not fire. THE PUBLISHER SAYS 2027-12-15, IN BOTH OF ITS ARTIFACTS -- and this session read the second one, which no prior lane had: the OIC/OCC backing JSON at www.optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar (HTTP 200, 34,871 bytes) AND the printed 2027 Options Expiration Calendar PDF (optionseducation.org/getmedia/210094f5-fac1-48e2-a148-74c52d8ea628, HTTP 200, 98,956 bytes), which is a raster with no text layer and was decoded to an image and read in-session: December 2027's purple "Monthly Volatility Products Expiration date" square sits on 15, and 22 is unmarked. THE TWO ARTIFACTS ARE NOT TWO DERIVATIONS -- the PDF's own note reads "accurate as of 12/18/2025" while the JSON's reads "1/2/2026" and the PDF's ModDate is 2026-08-05, so it is one authored dataset republished, and it does not raise the publisher's weight. WHAT SETTLES IT IS CBOE'S OWN RECORD, and it is unanimous. December 2027 is a 35-day-gap month: its next month's third Friday is 35 days after its own, so settlement lands FIVE DAYS AFTER the December monthly opex (2027-12-17) rather than two days before it. Cboe's per-contract history files, keyed by expiration date (cdn.cboe.com/data/us/futures/market_statistics/historical_data/VX/VX_<date>.csv), were probed for every realized 35-gap December: 2016-12-21, 2017-12-20, 2021-12-22, 2022-12-21 and 2023-12-20 each return a 187-193-row MONTHLY series, while the corresponding 2027-12-15-shaped date (2016-12-14, 2017-12-13, 2021-12-15, 2022-12-14, 2023-12-13) returns a 29-30-row WEEKLY. The 2010 and 2011 files 403 (the archive does not serve pre-2014), but Cboe's VRO_History.csv carries only monthlies before weeklies existed -- 77 of its 78 pre-2015 rows are rule-derived monthlies -- and it holds 2010-12-22 and 2011-12-21 while holding neither 2010-12-15 nor 2011-12-14. SEVEN OF SEVEN. Forward, the rule reproduces all NINE currently-listed VX monthlies (2026-09-16 through 2027-05-18), including the three 35-gap months among them, and 2027-05-18 is listed while 2027-05-19 is not -- Cboe applying the clause's FRIDAY leg (Juneteenth-observed 2027-06-18) to a live contract. Historically the rule reproduces 217 of 218 monthly settlements 2008-07 to 2026-08 (the absentee, 2013-05, is in Cboe's file at no date at all). FILED ESTIMATE, NOT CONFIRMED, on the lane's standing limits: VX/Z7 is on no Cboe surface (the settlement CSV strip re-fetched 2026-09-09 still stops at VX/K7 2027-05-18; VX_2027-12-22.csv and VX_2027-12-15.csv both 403, symmetrically, so that surface does not yet adjudicate), the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for an exchange rulebook, and this lane may not self-confirm. PROMOTION TRIGGER: VX/Z7 listed on a Cboe settlement or per-contract surface dated 2027-12-22. Discovered during the opex-2027-12-17 initial research; canonical file written by this event's own initial research (docs/research/events/vix-expiration-2027-12-22.md), checked 2026-09-09
notes: CANONICAL FILE written by this event's own initial research 2026-09-09 after reading the one prior proposal, proposals/vix-expiration-2027-12-22.from-opex-2027-12-17.json. THE PROPOSAL ASKED THE TAKING LANE NOT TO RESOLVE THE DATE BY PICKING THE EASIER SOURCE; it did not, and the answer changed shape. The proposal's argument was probabilistic -- a rule the publisher obeys 35 times and breaks once is better evidence than the once. That argument is WEAKER THAN IT LOOKS and this entry says so: of the 36 months the OCC calendar publishes, 13 are 35-day-gap months, the publisher renders 12 of 12 NON-DECEMBER ones at the rule's date, and the single 35-gap DECEMBER in the file is the one it renders seven days early. A publisher that is right 35 of 36 at random and a publisher with a December-specific defect fit the calendar equally well, so the calendar alone cannot separate them. WHAT SEPARATES THEM IS THAT CBOE HAS NO DECEMBER EXCEPTION, tested directly on the venue's own per-contract files rather than argued: all seven realized 35-gap Decembers since 2008 settled the monthly five days AFTER the December opex, never two days before it (2016/2017/2021/2022/2023 by a 187-193-row monthly series against a 29-30-row weekly at the alternative date; 2010/2011 by the pre-weekly VRO file, which holds the rule's date and not the alternative's). SO THE PUBLISHER'S ROW IS THE ERROR AND THIS ENTRY CARRIES THE RULE'S DATE. A CALENDAR-HYGIENE CONFLICT IS RECORDED AND NOT RESOLVED BY THIS LANE: proposals/vix-expiration-2027-12-15.from-fomc-minutes-2027-12-29.json proposes the SAME December 2027 settlement on the publisher's date, and its own id was due for initial research on the same day as this one. Two canonical entries for one settlement would double-count it. This lane writes only the file its own id names and never deletes or edits another lane's; the reconciliation is a calendar-coverage decision no single lane should take. NOTHING TRADEABLE IS CLAIMED. symbols is empty; impact low, matching every vix-expiration entry; trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md were re-grepped this session for opex|expiration|witching|volatility settlement|SOQ and return ZERO hits in both, so no house playbook is settlement-keyed. The proposer measured December quarterly expirations inert against the other three quarterly months on every channel (VIX P = 0.198, |S&P| P = 0.693, forward realized vol P = 0.372), and vix-expiration-2027-10-20 measured this class's blackout configurations inert on four channels each; nothing here reopens either. STRUCTURE, carried forward not acted on: the contract's 30-day reference window runs 2027-12-22 to 2028-01-21, 21 trading sessions with TWO closures inside it (2027-12-24 Christmas-observed and 2028-01-17 MLK) -- the only tracked VIX window in this calendar that spans a year boundary. 2027-12-31 is a trading day, not a closure: NYSE observes a Saturday holiday on the preceding Friday EXCEPT for New Year's Day, and 2028-01-01 is a Saturday. Estimate widens caution only; nothing here licenses an entry.
